nodes.title: Tracer bullet: Allocate and release a simulator for each scheduled node
nodes.why: M3 starts two independent iOS paths. Each node must receive a usable simulator before its first build. Closes #65
nodes.cuts: Trace scheduler assignment through .claude/workflows/run-plan.js, scripts/slice-env, scripts/xc and scripts/plan cleanup. Reuse the registry, machine guard and ownership checks. Extend scripts/plan-test and scripts/run-plan-test.

nodes.title: Align the design screens with current pairing and supported surfaces
nodes.why: First-run instructions must work on the current host and remain useful when M3 changes the transport. Closes #64
nodes.cuts: Update STORY.md, design/screens.json and design/screens/08.html, design/screens/L.html, design/screens/X1.html and design/screens/P1.html with their renders. Compare the current bridge CLI and bridge/README.md with the installed DSH pairing entry. Proposed for review: direct the user to obtain a fresh code on the host via the bridge CLI and scan or paste on the phone. Preserve the current LAN and two-ended Tailscale guidance. TLS enrollment belongs to M3.

nodes.title: Verify merge evidence and keep the rework budget across runs
nodes.why: M3 changes shared demo helpers and can span more than one workflow run. Closes #68
nodes.cuts: Use scripts/lib/plandata.py, scripts/plan, scripts/run-plan-args and .claude/workflows/run-plan.js. Extend scripts/plan-test and scripts/run-plan-test. Coordinate the persisted round state with the next slice for fresh-session handoff.

nodes.title: Hand off every rework round to a fresh build session
nodes.why: A new builder can act on the previous review without inheriting the old conversation. Closes #70
nodes.cuts: Keep the existing fresh-agent path in .claude/workflows/run-plan.js. Update scripts/brief and .agents/skills/run-plan/SKILL.md for normal and fallback coordination. Couple the handoff test to the persisted rounds from the previous slice.

nodes.title: Make human acceptance checks precise
nodes.why: The M3 physical iPhone check needs reliable human acceptance and an unambiguous terminal prompt. Closes #67
nodes.cuts: Use the existing command parser in the Claude/Codex hook path and adjust the confirmation in scripts/plan. Update .claude/hooks/plan-guard, its header, scripts/refusal-test, scripts/plan-test and their duplicated terminal-test helper. The user reviews, commits and merges protected hook changes.

nodes.title: Enforce test wrappers at pre-commit and in the bridge error demo
nodes.next: Real demo passed; user applies, commits and merges reviewed pre-commit hook
nodes.why: M3 migrates real-bridge demos and needs failures to retain their exit status and short summaries. Closes #69
nodes.cuts: Cover .githooks/pre-commit, scripts/check-wrappers, scripts/demo/bridge-errors.sh, the applicable wrapper and scripts/wrap-test. Keep the existing listener-error test selection and real-bridge UI path. The user reviews, commits and merges the protected pre-commit change.

nodes.title: Remove comments that repeat code and update the contributor rules
nodes.why: The next architecture change will move Swift feature code and demo helpers. Keep the source and slice brief clear before that move. Closes #66
nodes.cuts: Start with scripts/demo/pairing.sh, scripts/demo/all-tasks.sh, scripts/demo/session-page.sh and ios/dsh-mobile/Features/Transcript/StructuredTranscriptView.swift. Inspect ios/ and scripts/ for comments that merely repeat code. Add the convention to AGENTS.md and scripts/brief after the handoff work lands.

nodes.title: Remove stale process-document references from spikes
nodes.why: Readers of the archived experiments need working navigation to the current process. Closes #71
nodes.cuts: Extend scripts/check-old-docs to cover spikes/. On the current tree the obsolete references occur in the READMEs under spikes/x1-approval/, spikes/x2-noise/, spikes/x4-midtask/ and spikes/model-failures/, and in the x1-approval and x4-midtask runner comments. Keep the existing historical-link exception.

nodes.cuts: Find the cause. Fix it. Add a test that fails without the fix.
